# Paths the public mirror never receives. build/push_public.py stages
# `git archive <ref>`, removes every entry below and asserts it is absent
# before it builds the one orphan commit it pushes to the public main.
# One literal path per line (no globs), anchored to the repo root with a
# leading '/', so only the path named is dropped, never a same-named folder
# deeper in the tree: the nested docs/ folders, sdk/shared/docs/ among them,
# are published, and the tool asserts they are.
# Lines starting with '#' are comments. This file itself is published: it
# tells readers of the public repo what is filtered out.

/docs/
/.claude/
/AGENTS.md
/CLAUDE.md
/changes.patch
/llm_update.md
/gemini.geminirules
/sdk/.claude/
